d:
Ranchi men guru parv ke pavan avsar par aastha aur shraddha ka adbhut najara dekhne ko mila. is mauke par hajaron shraddhalu gurudvare pahunche aur mattha tekkar guru sahib ka aashirvad liya. pure parisar men bhakti aur seva ka mahaul dekhne ko mila. guru parv ko lekar shraddhaluon men khasa utsah najar aaya. dekhie ranchi se yah khas riporta.
